Decide attendance intervals for meetings on a shared timeline.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Avery, Jordan, Riley, Taylor

payload.content: Hello all, I am Taylor. I plan to attend the full Scheduled exam (10-11) since it's mandatory. For the soft meetings, I want to coordinate with Riley to overlap in the Study group (2-4) and Gaming session (3-5). Also, overlapping in Volleyball free play, Friends' hangout, and the later Study group would be beneficial. I encourage others to share their plans so we can maximize overlaps and avoid conflicts.

Hi everyone, Avery here. I agree that the Scheduled exam (10-11) should be attended fully since it's mandatory. For the soft meetings, I propose the following: attend Study group (2-4) fully to overlap with Taylor and Riley; attend Gaming session (3-5) partially, from 3 to 4 to avoid overlap penalty with Study group; attend Volleyball free play (7-10) fully to maximize overlap with Jordan, Riley, and Taylor; attend Friends’ hangout (8-10) partially from 8 to 10, overlapping with Volleyball free play, which is allowed as they start and end at the same time. I would like to hear others' thoughts on this plan.

Just to clarify, I intend to skip overlapping attendance intervals between Study group and Gaming session to avoid penalty since their windows partially overlap. I welcome any suggestions to improve this coordination.

Hello everyone, Jordan here. I agree with Avery's plan for Study group (2-4) and Gaming session (3-5) to avoid overlap penalty by attending Study group fully from 2 to 4 and Gaming session from 4 to 5. For Volleyball free play (7-10), I plan to attend fully to maximize overlap. For Friends' hangout (8-10), I propose attending fully to overlap with Avery and Taylor. For the later Study group (6-10), I suggest attending from 6 to 7 to avoid overlap with Volleyball and Friends' hangout. Thoughts on this?

Hi all, Riley here. I support Avery and Jordan's idea of attending Study group fully from 2 to 4, and then Gaming session from 4 to 5 to avoid overlap penalty. For Volleyball free play (7-10), I plan to attend fully to maximize overlap with you all. For Friends' hangout (8-10), I will attend fully as well, overlapping with Jordan, Avery, and Taylor. This way, we maximize overlaps and avoid penalties. Let me know if you have suggestions.

To everyone, Taylor here. I plan to attend the Scheduled exam fully from 10 to 11 as mandatory. For Study group (2-4) and Gaming session (3-5), I propose attending fully from 2 to 5 to overlap with Riley and others. For Volleyball free play (7-10), I will attend partially to avoid overlap penalty with Friends' hangout (8-10) which I plan to attend fully. For the later Study group (6-10), I plan to attend from 6 to 8, overlapping with Jordan if he attends early. Looking forward to your feedback to optimize our collective reward.

Hi all, Avery here again. I see some differences in proposed attendances for Gaming session (3-5) and Friends' hangout (8-10). To avoid penalties, I suggest: for Gaming session, I attend from 3 to 4 as planned, and perhaps Taylor and Riley can cover 4 to 5 fully. For Friends' hangout, since Jordan and Riley plan full attendance, perhaps I can attend from 8 to 9 to overlap with both and minimize penalty from overlapping Volleyball free play (7-10). Thoughts on this adjustment?

Also, to confirm, I plan to attend the full Scheduled exam (10-11) as it is mandatory. For Volleyball free play (7-10), I will attend fully to maximize overlap with everyone who agrees. Looking forward to hearing from Jordan, Riley, and Taylor about these plans.

Hi everyone, Jordan here. I like the coordination so far. I confirm attending Study group fully from 2 to 4 and Gaming session from 4 to 5 to avoid penalty. For Volleyball free play, I will attend fully from 7 to 10 to maximize overlap with all. For Friends' hangout, I'll attend fully from 8 to 10. For the later Study group (6-10), I'll adjust to attend from 6 to 7 to avoid overlapping Volleyball and Friends' hangout. Please confirm or suggest any changes.

Hi everyone, Taylor here. I confirm I will attend Scheduled exam fully (10-11). For Study group (2-4) and Gaming session (3-5), I plan to attend fully from 2 to 5 to overlap with Riley and others. I will attend Friends' hangout fully from 8 to 10 and cover the later Study group (6-8). I will partially attend Volleyball free play to avoid overlap penalty with Friends' hangout. Looking forward to everyone's feedback.

Hello everyone, Avery here. I appreciate the detailed plans shared so far. To summarize my current plan for clarity: I will attend the Study group fully from 2 to 4 to maximize overlap with all; attend Gaming session from 3 to 4 to avoid penalty with Study group; attend Volleyball free play fully from 7 to 10; and attend Friends' hangout from 8 to 9 to overlap with Jordan and Riley while minimizing penalty overlap with Volleyball free play. I will attend the Scheduled exam fully from 10 to 11. Please confirm if this works or suggest any improvements.

Hello all, Jordan here. I confirm my attendance for Study group from 2 to 4 and Gaming session from 4 to 5 as previously stated to avoid penalty. Please confirm if this plan fits with everyone's schedules or suggest any improvements to maximize our overlaps and minimize penalties.

Taylor, would you be able to confirm if you intend to attend Gaming session partially or fully, and how you plan to balance Volleyball free play with Friends' hangout since their windows overlap? This will help us finalize without penalties.

Hi everyone, Riley here. I plan to attend Study group fully from 2 to 4 and Gaming session fully from 3 to 5 to maximize overlap with others. For Volleyball free play, I will attend fully from 7 to 10. For Friends' hangout, I will attend partially from 8 to 10 to overlap with Taylor and others while minimizing overlap penalty. Hi all, Taylor here. To maximize coalition reward with Riley and avoid penalties, we plan to attend Study group fully from 2 to 4 and Gaming session fully from 3 to 5. Riley will attend Volleyball free play fully from 7 to 10, while I will attend Friends' hangout fully from 8 to 10 to avoid overlap penalty. Hello everyone, Avery here. I see some differences in plans for Gaming session and Friends' hangout. I want to confirm that I will skip any overlapping attendance between Study group and Gaming session to avoid penalty. I welcome any alternative suggestions to improve our joint rewards.

Hi all, Jordan here. To clarify and finalize my attendance: I will attend Study group fully from 2 to 4, then Gaming session from 4 to 5 to avoid overlap penalty with Study group. Since these overlap, would you consider attending Volleyball fully and Friends' hangout partially, or vice versa, to minimize penalties? Your input will help finalize our schedule.
